story.title: Cerebras AI chip maker on track for blockbuster IPO at $26.6B valuation amid OpenAI ties
story.summary: AI chip manufacturer Cerebras is advancing toward a major IPO that could value the company at $26.6 billion or more. The company has a deep commercial and technical relationship with OpenAI, which has helped fuel its growth trajectory. The listing would mark one of the largest AI-sector public offerings and reflects surging investor appetite for AI infrastructure plays.
